arrays.points: float32 (frames, 478, 3). NaN on a frame with found=False.
arrays.found: bool (frames,). False means NO DETECTION -- do not interpolate silently.
arrays.eyelid_aperture: float32 (frames, 2) = [subject-left, subject-right], lid gap in IRIS RADII. Scale-free, so it needs no per-shot constant.

topology_note: ORDERED rings, not sets -- fill them as polygons. Naming is anatomical (the SUBJECT, not the image), so for a subject facing camera the "left" ring is on the IMAGE RIGHT. mediapipe 468-472 is the RIGHT iris and 473-477 the LEFT; rounds 1-4 had those two swapped.

coordinates.space: pixels of source/frames/*.png, origin top-left, +x right, +y DOWN
coordinates.z: same units as x (scaled by width). RELATIVE depth about the head centre, not metric. Nothing may treat it as metric.
coordinates.anamorphic_warning: Spherical lens; stored pixels are already square.

gates: Anything drawn on the eye must pass BOTH found=True and a visibility gate. eyeBlink saturates late (it read 0.07 on a frame with visibly narrowed lids), so gate on eyelid_aperture as well.
why: Rounds 1-4 computed all 478 points, used two for an IPD and discarded the rest, so every eye/lip consumer had to re-run mediapipe in a second venv.
